description: SvDropDownList in Svelte 5 as a status and priority toolbar: compact single-select dropdowns with grouped options, type-ahead and animated portalled panels driving a live issue list. Controlled through value and onChange, themed from the --sg-* tokens.

faq.question: How is this different from a native select?
faq.answer: It renders a styled trigger and a portalled panel that supports groups, icons and theming, while keeping the select keyboard model: type-ahead, arrow keys, Enter and Escape.

faq.question: How do I animate the panel?
faq.answer: The open and close transitions are built in and respect reduced-motion settings; no extra configuration is needed.

faq.question: Can it be used as a grid cell editor?
faq.answer: Yes. A column with editorType 'list' mounts the same dropdown inside the cell with the column's editorOptions.
